knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Fraying is a reason for withdrawal regardless of how the strap feels. Positioning use does not change that.
The arrest loads the whole system, including the harness, the lanyard or absorber and the connectors. A competent individual decides, and the decision is recorded.
The back attachment point for fall arrest sits high on the back, centred. Waist and front points have other uses such as positioning.
The inspection section says an item should be inspected before each use and again afterwards.

practicalCriteria: Inspects a supplied harness and lanyard in the full order and records each criterion
Withdraws a supplied item with a planted defect, tags it and records the reason
Fits a harness on a person, and a second person confirms the fit against the checklist
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed inspection log for the supplied items
Assessor observation of inspection and fitting
stopWorkCriteria: Any item with a planted defect that is not withdrawn means the practical is failed and repeated
A harness worn with a visible fault is taken off and withdrawn before any further work
